messages:
sam_runtime: heads-up: p99 decode latency spiking across tok >1k requests since 11:04 UTC; streaming stalls reported
incident-bot: [ALERT] latency_slo_breach service=runtime p95=120ms p99=2.4s affected_pools=trt-flash pool_count=8
anna_ml: seeing tail at 3-4s on a few dedicated nodes in eu-west-1; traces show long compilepath step during first token
joe_oncall: confirming, reproducing on staging with the new compile flags (trt8 + flashattn-upgrade). dumping logs now
sam_runtime: paste of sample trace:
```
[2026-03-14T11:05:02Z] model=redwood-v1 variant=trt8-flash compilepath=kernel_v3 build=opt-flagX
decode: compile_path_ms=2200 kv_cache_lock=5ms total=3100ms
```
taylor_sre: paging/memory pressure? I see increased page-ins on those hosts. vmstat shows high si/so spikes around same time.
anna_ml: interesting — compile_path spikes correlated with first-request JIT-like kernel selection. subsequent requests are ok (p95 drops) -> points to compilepath regression
joe_oncall: customers impacted: cust-plat-a (eu) and cust-chat-2 (global). CS pinged @lee_csm
lee_csm: informed both customers, cust-chat-2 saw UI streaming freezes and a few 502s, engineering told to prioritize
sam_runtime: immediate mitigations applied: 1) blocked rollout of trt8-flash on further nodes 2) enabled fallback to cpu-quantized-v1 for new sessions 3) increased route weight to fallback region us-west-2
deploy-bot: rollback started for pool eu-west-1-trt-flash at 11:18 UTC by sam_runtime
anna_ml: repro steps for infra: run warmup with seq_len=2048 and measure compile_path_ms after applying new compiler flags. I have a small script here:
```
# run warmup
./bench --model redwood-v1 --variant trt8-flash --seq 2048 --iters 3
# capture compile_path ms from /var/log/runtime/compilepath.log
```
joe_oncall: temporary throttle rule applied to high-concurrency prefix sets to reduce new compile churn
taylor_sre: mitigating paging: increased swappiness to 10 and prepopulate page cache for GPU driver files; monitoring si/so
sam_runtime: tracking p95/p99 after mitigations; initial telemetry shows p99 dropping from 2.4s -> 850ms in affected pools
incident-bot: [UPDATE] incident severity reduced to SEV3. Root cause suspected: change in kernel selection heuristics + compiler flag X enabling a slow codepath for certain sequence lengths
anna_ml: next actions: 1) bisect compiler flags (toggle flagX) 2) run kernel A/B with and without flash-attn patch 3) instrument compilepath for latency buckets
joe_oncall: handoff -> @taylor_sre for overnight monitoring. Please escalate if p99 > 1.5s or error rate > 0.5%
sam_runtime: adding followups: open jira RINF-4219 (compilepath regression triage), RINF-4220 (automated rollback on compilepath spike), link to core traces
lee_csm: will keep customers updated and offer credits if SLA breached; note timestamps and affected request ids
taylor_sre: acked, I'm taking on-call. I'll post a summary in the morning with metric graphs and the bisect result
sam_runtime: thanks — if anything else pops, ping oncall and escalate via incident-bot :thumbsup:
